payload.detail: iaso: the owner's words contradict INT-009 (The 'won't: no GitHub Actions workflow is kept' line conflicts with the owner's earlier answer to the GitHub Actions question, which was 'Add a GitHub Actions workflow' (checks on Linux and Windows for every push and pull request). The owner's later answer to a similar question was 'Verify by hand now, no workflow (Recommended)', which supports the line. The two answers conflict with each other, so the owner has to say which one stands.): reword it to agree with them; the edit goes back to the judge
